import { headers, cookies } from 'next/headers'
import { after } from 'next/server'
import { revalidateTag } from 'next/cache'
import { getCacheHandler } from 'next/dist/server/use-cache/handlers'
import { mainValue, afterValue, nextRender, finishAfter, actualState, sharedTag } from '../../../cache-state.mjs'

export const runtime = 'nodejs'

export default async function Page({ params, searchParams }) {
  const [path, query, request, cookie] = await Promise.all([params, searchParams, headers(), cookies()])
  const count = nextRender()
  const expiration = await getCacheHandler('default').getExpiration([sharedTag])
  const first = await mainValue()
  const second = await mainValue()
  const fromAfter = query.observeAfter === 'yes' ? await afterValue() : null
  const row = {
    count,
    id: path.id,
    label: query.label,
    language: request.get('accept-language'),
    cookie: cookie.get('scope')?.value ?? null,
    first,
    second,
    fromAfter,
    expiration,
    state: actualState(),
  }
  if (query.invalidate === 'yes') {
    after(async () => {
      // Actual expiry applies strictly after the cached value's timestamp.
      // Wait for that real clock boundary, without inventing an expiry value.
      while (Date.now() <= first.createdAt) await new Promise(resolve => setImmediate(resolve))
      const value = await afterValue()
      revalidateTag(sharedTag, { expire: 0 })
      const completed = finishAfter()
      console.log('SHARED_CACHE_AFTER ' + JSON.stringify({ id: path.id, label: query.label, value, completed, state: actualState() }))
    })
  }
  return <pre id="shared-cache-values">{JSON.stringify(row)}</pre>
}
